interpretation: The proven native original survived its earlier native-cloud close/reopen. Uploading the exact same package, editing and saving it reproduced invisibility on fresh reopen in this Excel-web session, even though drawing XML, image bytes and relationship chain remain byte-identical. This is a strong observed native-creation versus upload-path distinction, not proof of a vendor bug, root cause, XML deletion or producer incompatibility.

privacy: No account/drive IDs, full URLs, query/auth tokens or raw account screenshots are saved in the report. Exact XLSX byte copies naturally retain ordinary Office creator/last-modifier metadata; those names are not echoed. Safe cropped JPEG screenshots are verified nonblank.
